name: goal_centered_f2c_matched_public_axes_v3
wearing_shift: Six users: source training domain; four held-out wearing domains. Validation users 15-17, descriptive final users 18-20. Native 8 channels at 200 Hz, 40 samples/window. Source-only Rest F0 and centered F2c reference; class-balanced logistic classifier per subject.
manus_session: Six users: Session1 source, Session2 validation, Session3 descriptive final. Native 8 channels at 200 Hz, 40 samples/window. Source-only external Rest prior and centered F2c reference; fixed fit_predict classifier.
grab_unseen_user: Day1 subjects 1-4 source, 5-6 validation, 7-8 descriptive final. Native 8 forearm channels at 2048 Hz, 512 samples/window; official checksums. Source-only Rest F0 and centered F2c reference; fixed logistic classifier.
decision: Use only matched validation trial-level F1 and log loss on all three axes for the existing default-bank guard. Final groups are descriptive; prior public inspection forbids an independent confirmation claim.
boundary: Public-data scope; no own-device 250 Hz, anatomical ring-order or live-recognition claim.
